slides.headline: We won't guarantee your review comes down. Here's why that's good news.
The platform makes the final call.
slides.body: Not us, not anyone. A guarantee on an outcome nobody controls is a guess.

slides.headline: What we do control:
slides.body: which cases we take, how each one is handled, and how hard we follow it through.

slides.headline: So we carry the risk instead.
slides.body: You pay when it's gone. If it stays up, you owe nothing.

slides.headline: Three questions to ask any provider — us included.
slides.body: Do you charge before it's removed? What if it doesn't come down? What exactly am I agreeing to pay?

slides.headline: Vague answers are the red flag.
slides.body: Not the lack of a guarantee.

slides.headline: Send us the link. We'll tell you if it may have a case.
slides.sub: You only pay once it's gone.
